```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "tsardom_of_russia_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- sprintf("%.1fk", v / 1000.0)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", s)
    return(s)
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  lat_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lat))), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lon))), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```


# Gazetteer Structure and 38-Region Coverage (1400AD - 1721AD)

This settlement gazetteer accompanies the demographic literature review for the Tsardom of Russia, Baltic Provinces, Lithuanian-Polish Rus, and Siberian Colonisation (1400AD - 1721AD) and compiles `r length(settlements_list)` individual georeferenced settlements across all 38 period-authentic regions spanning Russia and Siberia (109 settlements across Regions 18-38), Ukraine and Crimea (47 settlements across Regions 9-17), Estland-Livland, Courland-Inflanty, Core Lithuania, and Old Finland (27 settlements across Regions 1-4), and Belarus (22 settlements across Regions 5-8) in tsardom_of_russia_settlements.json [@Vodarsky1973; @Vodarsky1977; @Kabuzan1963; @Palli1996; @Dunsdorfs1962; @Kiaupa2000; @KarpachevKozlovsky1972; @Yakovenko2006; @Dolgikh1960]. Every Hanseatic port, Magdeburg-law town (*miasteczko*), ducal residence, Swedish border fortress, Cossack regimental capital, southern abatis-line stronghold, Ural salt or ironworks settlement, and Siberian *ostrog* is recorded as an independent entry in strict population_Stadester 6-key format (name, other_names, coords, country, key, population) with decimal-degree coordinates ([lat, lon]) and positive integer population benchmarks across its documented period of occupation between 1400AD and 1720AD [@Tikhomirov1962; @Bernotas2013; @Sharukho2010; @Rezun1989; @Zhigalov2024].

Population series are derived from Baltic *Hakenrevisionen* and municipal burger rolls, the 1528AD Lithuanian *Popis* and *Voloka* / *podymne* hearth registers, Muscovite land cadastres (*pistsovye knigi*), the 1646AD and 1678AD Household Censuses (*perepisnye knigi*), the First Poll-Tax Revision (1719-1721AD, *revizskie skazki*), Left-Bank Ukrainian *perepysni knyhy* (1666AD) and regimental *komputy*, Ottoman *tahrir defterleri* for Crimea and Kefe, and Siberian *yasak* and *dozornye* books [@Shapiro1974; @Morzy1965; @Vasiliauskas2012; @Saloheimo1976; @Irtenina2022; @Ozturk2019; @Pokrovsky1984]. Zero-population placeholders are omitted so that each settlement's benchmark keys reflect its active historical span within the 1400AD - 1721AD domain.

```{r tab-region-summary, echo=FALSE}
sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(reg_ids), function (i) {
  rid <- reg_ids[i]
  sub_s <- Filter(function (s) identical(as.character(settlement_reg_lookup[[as.character(s$key)]]), rid), settlements_list)
  n_s <- length(sub_s)
  sum_yr <- function (yr) {
    sum(vapply(sub_s, function (s) {
      v <- s$population[[yr]]
      if (is.null(v)) 0 else as.numeric(v)
    }, numeric(1)))
  }
  data.frame(
    Region = reg_labels[i],
    RegionID = rid,
    Count = as.character(n_s),
    Pop1400 = fmt_num_eu(sum_yr("1400")),
    Pop1550 = fmt_num_eu(sum_yr("1550")),
    Pop1648 = fmt_num_eu(sum_yr("1648")),
    Pop1678 = fmt_num_eu(sum_yr("1678")),
    Pop1720 = fmt_num_eu(sum_yr("1720")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_yr <- function (yr) {
  sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) if (is.null(s$population[[yr]])) 0 else as.numeric(s$population[[yr]]), numeric(1)))
}
df_sum <- rbind(
  df_sum,
  data.frame(
    Region = "Total Gazetteer (All 38 Regions)",
    RegionID = "all_38_regions",
    Count = as.character(length(settlements_list)),
    Pop1400 = fmt_num_eu(tot_yr("1400")),
    Pop1550 = fmt_num_eu(tot_yr("1550")),
    Pop1648 = fmt_num_eu(tot_yr("1648")),
    Pop1678 = fmt_num_eu(tot_yr("1678")),
    Pop1720 = fmt_num_eu(tot_yr("1720")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)
render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Regional summary of catalogued settlements and combined urban and garrison populations across five benchmark dates (1400AD - 1720AD).",
    col_names = c("Period-Authentic Region", "Region ID", "Count", "1400AD", "1550AD", "1648AD", "1678AD", "1720AD"),
    label = "tab:gazetteer-summary"
  )
)
```

# Benchmark Matrix of Principal Settlements (1400AD - 1720AD)

```{r tab-benchmark-matrix, echo=FALSE}
build_matrix_df <- function (arg0_list) {
  rows <- lapply(arg0_list, function (s) {
    rid <- as.character(settlement_reg_lookup[[as.character(s$key)]])
    rshort <- if (rid %in% names(reg_num_map)) paste0(reg_num_map[[rid]], " (", rid, ")") else rid
    data.frame(
      Name = as.character(s$name),
      RegionID = rshort,
      Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
      Y1400 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1400, 1450),
      Y1500 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1480, 1520),
      Y1550 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1540, 1585),
      Y1600 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1595, 1620),
      Y1648 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1640, 1670),
      Y1678 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1675, 1690),
      Y1720 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1700, 1721),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

df_mat <- build_matrix_df(settlements_list)
render_table_template(
  df_mat,
  list(
    caption = "Benchmark population series for all 205 catalogued settlements by historical region across seven dates (1400AD - 1720AD).",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Period Region", "Coordinates", "1400-1450AD", "1500AD", "1550-1580AD", "1600-1615AD", "1648-1667AD", "1678AD", "1700-1720AD"),
    label = "tab:benchmark-matrix"
  )
)
```

# Complete Georeferenced Settlement Directory (1400AD - 1721AD)

```{r tab-full-directory, echo=FALSE}
dir_rows <- lapply(settlements_list, function (s) {
  rid <- as.character(settlement_reg_lookup[[as.character(s$key)]])
  data.frame(
    Name = as.character(s$name),
    AltNames = fmt_other_names(s),
    RegionID = rid,
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Series = fmt_pop_series(s, 1400, 1721),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_dir <- do.call(rbind, dir_rows)
render_table_template(
  df_dir,
  list(
    caption = "Directory of all 205 catalogued settlements with historical names, regions, coordinates, occupation spans, and benchmark populations (1400AD - 1720AD).",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical & Alternative Names", "Region ID", "Coordinates", "Active Span", "Population Series (Year: Population)"),
    label = "tab:full-directory"
  )
)
```
